title: Ok as a sofa throw,  but not as soft as expected
text:
Ok as a sofa throw, but not as soft as expected. Update and reduced to 2 stars. After two weeks the thing is unraveling at the seams. Loose threads everywhere now and it looks terrible.
************************************
I love the white, fluffy, sherpa side of this blanket. It weighs very little and is a great little sofa throw while reading. It is also very soft and warm. It's just the reverse side with the waffle pattern that I don't care for. The texture is rough to the touch and does not feel anything like the white side. It feels stiff and the opposite of cozy actually. I thought it might just be me, but my dogs don't want to snuggle on the waffle weave side either.
